Add a TLS Signature Score

add_tls_score.Rd

Scores each cell for a TLS gene signature with [Seurat::AddModuleScore()], which corrects for background expression using control gene sets. Genes not in the assay are dropped with a message.

Usage

add_tls_score(
  seurat_obj,
  genes = tls_signature_genes(),
  assay = "Xenium",
  score_name = "TLS_score",
  ctrl = NULL,
  nbin = 24,
  min_genes = 3,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

seurat_obj

Seurat object.

genes

Signature genes (default: [tls_signature_genes()]).

assay

Assay name. If its `data` layer is empty, [Seurat::NormalizeData()] is run with default settings.

score_name

Metadata column to store the score in.

ctrl

Number of control genes per signature gene. Defaults to the number of genes present, bounded to 5-50 and capped by the genes available per expression bin, which suits small panels.

nbin

Number of expression bins for control gene selection; lower this if AddModuleScore fails on small panels.

min_genes

Minimum signature genes that must be present.

seed

Random seed passed to AddModuleScore.

Value

Seurat object with the score in metadata column `score_name`.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
seurat_obj <- add_tls_score(seurat_obj, assay = "Xenium")
} # }
